statement: For valid-sized guest WriteData requests, pinned Dolphin assigns InvalidAddress on out-of-range EEPROM writes and sends the final WriteData ACK carrying that error (input report 0x22), rather than a memory-read-result input 0x21. Invalid sizes are silently ignored earlier in its handler. rnconrad routes the analogous out-of-range write through a memory-result/error reply. The implementations disagree about report type; no physical-device outcome is established.

applicability.revision: Historical independent software emulators, not physical hardware revisions
applicability.scope: EmuSubroutines.cpp lines 267-272 (size precondition), 280-283 (range error), and 321-322 (ACK for the accepted request); this is source compatibility behavior, not device-side physical validation.
